scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.dialogue: One peaceful evening in Whispering Woods, Barnaby Bear and Squeaky Squirrel were taking a walk. Suddenly, they heard a tiny, twinkly sob. 'What's wrong?' asked Barnaby. 'I'm a little star, and I fell from the sky!' said the Lost Star. 'Don't worry,' said Squeaky, 'we'll help you get home!'

scenes.dialogue: Barnaby and Squeaky knew they had to get the star back to the sky. 'We need to find the tallest tree in the woods!' said Barnaby. 'Follow me!' chirped Squeaky, scampering ahead. They searched high and low, until they spotted a giant oak tree reaching up to the stars.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.dialogue: Barnaby tried to climb, but the branches were too high. 'I can help!' said Squeaky, and she scurried up the tree, carrying the star gently in her bushy tail. But the star was still too low. 'We need one more push!' said Barnaby. Together, they counted, 'One, two, three... heave!' and the star floated up, up, up!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.dialogue: The star soared into the night sky and twinkled brightly. 'Thank you, friends!' it called. Barnaby and Squeaky waved goodnight, feeling warm and happy inside. And from that night on, the star always shone a little brighter over Whispering Woods, reminding them that helping friends makes the world a brighter place.
